_comment: RNG-22 fidelity corpus. Adding a photo is an entry here plus the file -- no code change. An entry whose file is absent is reported as a declared gap, not a failure.

photos.note: MISNAMED, kept for continuity: the centre is a square step cut with rounded corners and four corner prongs, not a round brilliant. Pre-RNG-33 vision said so in its free text and was forced to write `round`; since CP4 it produces a CUSHION, which is the more faithful reading. The archetype expectation below is what this entry actually pins
oval centre in a halo with pave shoulders -- the RNG-24 evidence photo (the union forces one choice and the shoulders vanish)
round centre in a halo with pave shoulders; PNG exercises the other magic-byte branch
oval centre with round side stones; converted from WebP because RNG-28 is still open

round centre, six prongs, accents down both shoulders. Vision reads it SOLITAIRE, 3/3 on both the pre- and post-RNG-33 prompts, describing 'pave accent band' / 'diamond-set shoulders' in free text -- so the mismatch is pre-existing and is RNG-24's complaint, not a vision failure: these shoulders are PAVE and our side_stone archetype expresses `retention='channel'` only (pave deferred in RNG-11). The expectation here is arguably the thing that is wrong; left as-is so the amber keeps pointing at RNG-24
four-prong solitaire, cushion centre at L:W ~1.0 -- rounded corners and outward-bowed sides. The cut vision NAMED on RNG-22's first run and had to write `round`, which is why RNG-33 exists
four-prong solitaire, emerald step cut at L:W ~1.45 -- straight sides, cut corners, parallel steps rather than brilliant facets; prongs grip the cut corners
six-prong solitaire, pear at L:W ~1.55 with a clearly visible V-PRONG at the point -- the retention feature RNG-33 CP3 builds, so this photo is also the check that we read it

six-prong solitaire, marquise at L:W ~1.9, points at both ends. YELLOW gold on a busy textured background in natural light -- the only corpus entry that is not a clean studio shot, so it exercises metal colour and background clutter as well as the cut
not a ring; passes when the classifier declines to detect one
